reel_angle.fan_question: Was it all Yoro's red card?
reel_angle.data_answer: The red made it worse but did not create the gap. Before it (0-8') Liverpool already had 3 shots and 0.40 xG to United's 1 shot and 0.04. After it Liverpool had 25 shots and 3.98 xG to United's 9 and 0.59. Over 90 minutes United created 0 big chances to Liverpool's 7 and had 9 touches in Liverpool's box to 60.
